text: According to Sea Limited's FY2025 20-F, Free Fire was made unavailable on the Google Play Store and iOS App Store in India in early 2022 due to unanticipated government actions, and it "currently remains unavailable" as of the FY2025 filing [Sea, FY2025, p.10].

answer: According to Sea Limited's FY2025 20-F, Free Fire was made unavailable on the Google Play Store and iOS App Store in India in early 2022 due to unanticipated government actions, and it "currently remains unavailable" as of the FY2025 filing [Sea, FY2025, p.10].
